title: Gary’s First Encounter With Multi-Sensory Perception
fullTitle: Soul Snack #22: Gary’s First Encounter With Multi-Sensory Perception
description: In this fascinating Soul Snack, Gary reflects on his earliest experiences of multi-sensory perception and how they shaped his journey toward authentic power. He shares the pivotal moments that first made him aware that there was more to life than the physical world , including a powerful encounter with his grandmother after her transition from the Earth school, and the profound experience of writing The Dancing Wu Li Masters .

Gary recounts how, for much of his early life, he was controlled by frightened parts of his personality—seeking validation through external power, addiction, and a relentless pursuit of self-satisfaction. However, his introduction to quantum physics and his unexpected passion for writing led him to realize that something greater was at play.
The key takeaway from this episode is that multi-sensory perception is not something we “achieve”—it is something we awaken to .
